files.README.md:
# Sonarr operations

Choose one or more Sonarr integrations in Connections. Each server contributes an independent calendar, missing list and queue. A failed server leaves other results visible. Search controls always name the selected server. Expand for the detailed view.

The server uses getWidgetConnectionGroup(context, "sonarr") to enumerate the repeatable connection requirement; adding a server requires no source edit.
